comparison.objective: Candidate commissions an industrial-axis damper; record lays out a Japanese meal in prescribed diner-relative positions and orientations.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses a hex key, controlled collar rotation, bimanual stabilization, torque-limited locking, and test cycling; record uses object placement and semantic spatial orientation.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires safe repeatable carriage deceleration and retained adjustment. Record requires rice left, soup right, and fish head left but supplies no specs or numeric placement tolerances.
comparison.reason: Semantic table setting tests spatial arrangement, not mechanical adjustment or dynamic energy absorption.
